column1: # Phase 5d: ADempiere-owned replacements for ZK APIs the CE 10 target removed.
# Every row is a reviewed decision, not a scan result, and that is why it lives
# in its own file: the replacement classes deliberately contain NO reference to
# the namespace they replace - gradle/phase5/zk-compile-closure.gradle fails the
# build if one does - so no amount of grepping the source can discover this
# mapping. scripts/phase5/generate-inventories.sh emits these rows verbatim into
# `verifyPhase5dCurrentZkInventory` fails if a named replacement file does not
# The three families and why each one had to be replaced:
#   org.zkoss.zkex   ZK Professional Edition. Not obtainable without a
#                    introducing evaluation artifacts or commercial repository
#   org.zkoss.zkmax  ZK Enterprise Edition, same constraint.
#   org.zkforge      ZK 3.x community add-ons that were never published for ZK
